extra_constraints:
- PR-A is already on this branch (HEAD): the generated clients and the hand-written onboarding models carry `narrative?: string | null`. Do not touch generated files, swagger, or anything under backend/.
- Every copy string comes from spec section 4 (the component map is the source of source strings: sentence case; CSS uppercases). Write U+2014, U+00B7, U+2026 as `\u2014`, `\u00B7`, `\u2026` escapes in TSX and in tests. Never bake uppercase into a stored string.
- Preserved contracts (spec section 1.B and 3 PR-B): the page spec, schema spec, helpers spec, and API spec keep passing without loosening; field `name`s and `{name}-field` testids are unchanged; `onboarding-units-field`, `onboarding-submit`, `onboarding-building`, `onboarding-form-alert`, `goal-field`, `days-field` stay; idempotency behavior (fresh UUID per mount, same key across retries and after a 422, rotation on incomplete success) is unchanged and now pinned by the 422 test.
- Day chips: add a `short` field to `DAY_OPTIONS` for the visible text (`Mo`..`Su`); `aria-label` keeps `label` (`Mon`..`Sun`). Chips are `min-h-11`. The e2e day-chip clicks by name `Mon`/`Wed` must keep working.
- Building overlay: `BuildingPlanSurface` with `className="fixed inset-0 z-50"` inside `<div data-testid="onboarding-building">`, shown while `isLoading || isBuilding`; the `<form>` gets React 19's boolean `inert` prop while the overlay shows; the form stays mounted so a 422 returns it with values intact.
- Semantic tokens only (no raw hex, no `--alp-faint` on essential text); every animation pairs a `motion-reduce:` variant; 44px targets on every interactive element; keep FormLabel/FormControl/FormDescription/FormMessage wiring and `role="alert"` messages.
- Sandbox limits you must report as Deviations instead of working around: `npm run e2e` (needs the running stack), `npm run check-contrast` and the full `npm run test` (the `tsx` runner cannot open its IPC pipe here). Run `npx vitest run <file>` per touched spec instead, plus `npm run build`, `npx eslint`, `npx prettier --check` on every touched file. Hand the orchestrator the exact e2e and check-contrast commands.
- Dual-theme test: use `renderInBothThemes` from `frontend/src/app/modules/common/test-utils/render-in-both-themes.tsx` for the new form tests, as the Slice 2 and 3 component specs do.
